page.layout: One page of text, single column; a running head at the top; a woodcut ornament band mid-page; a division heading "HOMILIA quinta" with a sub-heading and a list of verses below. No margin notes.

main_text.p: vnà cum gloria & præsentia illius qui sedet ad dextram patris, & nomen supra omne nomen adeptus est, illius facti cohæredes conspecturi 1.Cor. 2.9.1.Pet.3.7.Rom.8.17.Ioh.17.2. Quis inquam, humani viribus ingenij res istas tantas tamque obstupendas comprehendat? Adoremus igitur quæ captum nostrum superant: & à tam vasta, tamque profunda miseriarum voragine, ad tam immensam gloriam cuecti, ne benedictionem Esaui Iacobi benedictioni præferamus: sed paulatim ex his terris emergentes per Spiritum qui nobis datus est, magis ac magis sursum efferamur, ad illius paradisi non fallaces delicias, eo vocante nos & expectante qui in hoc horto terrestri & miseriarum pleno luctatus aduersus Satanam, peccatum & mortem, tandem ea debellauit & de illis feliciter triumphum reportauit.
main_text.head: HOMILIA quinta.
MATTH. 26.

p.i: 36. Et dicit discipulis, Sedete hic, vsque quo abiens precatus fuero illic.
37. Et assumpto Petro & duobus filiis Zebedæi, cœpit contristari, & grauissimè angi.
38. Tunc dicit eis Iesus, Vndiquaque tristis est anima mea...

page.notes: The ornament band and the word "quinta" in italic lowercase are set as printed; the last line of verse 38 is cut off at the line end ("anim-"). The reading of the final word of verse 38 is uncertain.
